confirm.docLossBody: Browser storage is unavailable or full, so you won’t be able to get this document back from “Recent documents” after switching. Continue anyway?
confirm.replaceAssetBody_one: This figure has {{count}} edit tied to the original script. Swapping the asset clears it — undoable — while position, size, crop and stacking order stay.
confirm.replaceAssetBody_other: This figure has {{count}} edits, bound to elements of the original script, so they’ll be cleared when you swap the asset (undoable). Position, size, crop and stacking order are kept.
confirm.resetOverridesBody_one: This figure returns to what the source script generates now. Clearing its {{count}} edit is undoable; your script and file stay untouched.
confirm.resetOverridesBody_other: This figure returns to what the source script currently generates. {{count}} edits are cleared (undoable); the source script and original file stay as they are, and other figures from the same file are unaffected.
confirm.resetOverridesBodyBaked: These edits were written back to the original file. Reverting returns this figure to what the source script currently generates (undoable); the original file and script stay as they are, and other figures from the same file are unaffected.

crash.body: Your document is saved locally; reloading resumes from the last snapshot. If it fails again after reloading, choose “Open a blank document”; nothing is deleted, and the document is available under “Recent documents”.
crash.title: Something went wrong
